approves the appointment of the following persons as Cabinet Secretaries– No.
Name Office
Hon. (Prof.) Kithure Kindiki, EGH Ministry of Interior & National Administration.
Dr. Debra Mulongo Barasa Ministry of Health.
Hon. Alice Wahome, EGH Ministry of Lands, Public Works, Housing & Urban Development.
Mr. Julius Migos Ogamba, EBS Ministry of Education.
Hon Roselinda Soipan Tuya
Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja
Hon. Aden Barre Duale, EGH
Mr. Eric Muriithi Mugaa
Mr. Davis Chirchir, EGH
EGH
Name Office
Dr. Margaret Nyambura Ndung’u Ministry of Information, Communication & the Digital Economy.
Hon. John Mbadi Ng’ongo, EGH The National Treasury and Economic Planning.
Hon. Salim Mvurya Mgala, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Investments, Trade & Industry.
Ms. Rebecca Miano, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Tourism and Wildlife.
Hon. James Opiyo Wandayi, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Energy and Petroleum.
Hon. Onesmus Kipchumba Murkomen, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Youth Affairs, Creative Economy and Sports.
Hon. Hassan Ali Joho, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs.
Hon. (Dr.) Alfred Nganga Mutua, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Labour and Social Protection.
Hon. Wycliffe Ambetsa Oparanya, EGH Cabinet Secretary, Ministry of Co- operatives & Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Development.
Hon Justin Bedan Njoka
rejects the appointment of Ms. Stella Soi Lang’at as the Cabinet Secretary,
Muturi,

note: House approval vote for nominees1–19 only, per Hansard1230. Does not establish the separately announced rejection vote.
